heading: Introduction
content: Welcome to Blockchain Management! We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. If you have any questions or concerns about this privacy notice, or our practices with regards to your personal information, please contact us at support@bcmanagement.us or by mail at 2 E Benton St, Iowa City, IA 52240, United States. When you visit our website https://bcmanagement.us/, and more generally, use any of our services, we appreciate that you are trusting us with your personal information. We take your privacy very seriously. In this privacy notice, we seek to explain to you in the clearest way possible what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have in relation to it. Please read this privacy policy carefully, as it will help you understand what we do with the information that we collect.

heading: What Information Do We Collect?
content: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you visit the Website, express an interest in obtaining information about us or our blockchain management services, when you request a consultation, or otherwise when you contact us. The personal information that we collect depends on the context of your interactions with us and the Website, the choices you make, and the services you use. The personal information we collect may include the following:

heading: Personal Information Provided by You:
content: We collect names; phone numbers; email addresses; mailing addresses; job titles; contact preferences; and other similar information.

sublist.heading: Business Information:
sublist.content: If you represent a business, we may collect information such as the business name, industry, size, and other relevant details.

sublist.heading: Consultation Request Data:
sublist.content: Information related to the specific blockchain management services you are interested in or request a consultation for.

heading: How Do We Use Your Information?
content: We use personal information collected via our Website for a variety of business purposes described below. We process your personal information for these purposes in reliance on our legitimate business interests, in order to enter into or perform a contract with you, with your consent, and/or for compliance with our legal obligations.

sublist.content: To respond to consultation inquiries and provide information about our blockchain management services.
To facilitate communication and provide tailored information about our services.
To fulfill and manage consultation requests.
To personalize your experience and tailor our services to your needs.
To send administrative information to you.

heading: Will Your Information Be Shared With Anyone?
content: We may process or share your data that we hold based on the following legal basis:

sublist.heading: Consent:
sublist.content: We may process your data if you have given us specific consent to use your personal information for a specific purpose.

sublist.heading: Legitimate Interests:
sublist.content: We may process your data when it is reasonably necessary to achieve our legitimate business interests.

sublist.heading: Performance of a Contract:
sublist.content: Where we have entered into a contract with you, we may process your personal information to fulfill the terms of our contract.

sublist.heading: Legal Obligations:
sublist.content: We may disclose your information where we are legally required to do so to comply with applicable law, governmental requests, a judicial proceeding, court order, or legal process.

sublist.heading: Vital Interests:
sublist.content: We may disclose your information where we believe it is necessary to investigate, prevent, or take action regarding potential violations of our policies, suspected fraud, situations involving potential threats to the safety of any person, and illegal activities.

heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies
content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies on our Website to help customize the Website and improve your experience. A cookie is a small file placed on your device that enables various features and functionality. For more information on how to manage cookies, including opt-out of cookies for various services, visit www.allaboutcookies.org.

sublist.heading: Essential Cookies:
sublist.content: These cookies are essential for enabling user movement around our Website and providing access to features such as your consultation form, contact preferences, and other secure areas of the Website. This category of cookies cannot be disabled.

sublist.heading: Analytics and Performance Cookies:
sublist.content: These cookies are used to collect information about traffic to our Website and how users use our Website.

sublist.heading: Functionality Cookies:
sublist.content: These cookies remember choices you make such as language preference, service preferences, or other online settings and provide personalized or enhanced features that you select.

sublist.heading: Targeting and Advertising Cookies:
sublist.content: These cookies may track your browsing habits and location to provide you with advertising in line with your interests.

heading: How Do We Handle Your Consultation Form Submissions?
content: If you choose to contact us through our website’s consultation form, we may collect and store the information you provide for the purpose of responding to your inquiry and providing you with the requested information.

heading: How Long Do We Keep Your Information?
content: We will only keep your personal information for as long as it is necessary for the purposes set out in this privacy policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

heading: How Do We Keep Your Information Safe?
content: We aim to protect your personal information through a system of organizational and technical security measures.

heading: Do We Collect Information from Minors?
content: We do not knowingly solicit data from or market to individuals under 18 years of age.

heading: What Are Your Privacy Rights?
content: You have certain rights regarding your personal information, subject to local data protection laws.

sublist.heading: Controls for Do-Not-Track Features:
sublist.content: Most web browsers and some mobile operating systems and mobile applications include a Do-Not-Track ('DNT') feature or setting you can activate to signal your privacy preference not to have data about your online browsing activities monitored and collected.

sublist.heading: Do Iowa Residents Have Specific Privacy Rights?
sublist.content: If you are a resident of Iowa, you may have specific rights regarding access to your personal information.

heading: Do We Make Updates to This Policy?
content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The updated version will be indicated by an updated 'Revised' date, and the updated version will be effective as soon as it is accessible.

heading: How Can You Contact Us About This Policy?
content: If you have questions or comments about this policy, you may email us at support@bcmanagement.us or by post to: Blockchain Management 2 E Benton St, Iowa City, IA 52240, United States
